headline: A floating browser, a hand with commits, and a smoother workspace.

features.title: Pop the browser out into a floating window
features.description: Lift the built-in browser into a small window that floats above your work and stays put while you move and resize it. Perfect for keeping a live preview in view without giving up room for the thing you're building.

features.title: Get a hand writing commits and pull requests
features.description: Scient can now draft commit messages and pull request summaries for you, taking cues from your project's own recent history so they read like they belong. You stay in control and can edit anything before it's used.

features.title: Smoother typing and a tidier layout
features.description: Composing feels steadier: pressing Enter while typing in languages that use input composition no longer sends your message early, zoom shortcuts behave as expected, and the space between your conversation and the composer stays neat while a task panel is open.

features.title: Faster to start, and more private
features.description: The app now carries its own fonts instead of fetching them from the web, so it loads cleanly on first run and keeps more of your activity to itself.

features.title: Steadier previews and connections
features.description: Local previews stay live as your files change, updates to your connected tools wait for your confirmation, and the app recovers more gracefully if something hiccups quietly in the background.
